title: Notes on Hallgren's efficient quantum algorithm for solving Pell's equation
supports: Quadratic ideals, canonical reduced pairs, reduction steps, ideal composition, logarithmic generator distance, and efficient real-position evaluation.
note: Sections2–10 read. Distances consistently use J=O/alpha and ln(alpha), not the later Hallgren conjugate-ratio convention. General composition formula independently checked on d=3. Hallgren2006 random shifts supply the finite-precision safeguard; do not rely on inter-ideal separation alone.
